notes.title: Update #1: Assault Rifle!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34100524/a508a5dbce05e32493a6f8fefafaf0c4128c71b4.jpg

You know what they say: Never bring a knife to a gunfight.

Well, you can do vice versa. The new update lets you wield an assault rifle and do some serious damage with it... that is, if you can find ammunition.

Buy now, get the 10% discount and bring a gun to a sword fight.

What's new:


 Introduction of the assault rifle
 New level up system
 Bug fixes
